title: Rubber
description: &6Rubber&r is an essential material used in many crafting recipes. It is created in a &3Chemical Plant&r with &bUnsaturated Hydrocarbons&r obtained from a &3Catalytic Cracking Tower&r.
&6Latex&r is a rubber alternative which can be used in some recipes instead of normal rubber. It can be created early on using a &3Burner Press&r by processing dandelions or jungle wood.
